default_cta.description: Used when a request and the Brand Kit give none, for example Book now.
default_cta.title: Default call to action

knowledge_folder.description: Top-level Knowledge folder. Each content type gets its own subfolder inside it, for example Social posts/Articles.
knowledge_folder.title: Drafts folder in Knowledge

posts_per_week.description: Optional. Every Monday the agent adds social posts to next week until it has this many, each built around one of your Brand Kit's key messages. Leave empty or 0 to plan everything yourself.
posts_per_week.title: Posts per week (rhythm top-up)

review_lead_days.description: The reviewer is asked to approve a draft this many business days before its publish date.
review_lead_days.title: Review lead time (business days before publishing)

time_zone.description: Review and publish dates and reminders use this time zone, whoever asks for the content.
time_zone.title: Time zone

description: Where drafts are saved, the time zone the agent works in and how much review time to leave. People (manager, backup and reviewer) are set when you activate the agent.
name: Social Media Agent setup
